summary: Backend-only regression test for QBO mapper id namespacing fix. Ran the 7 targeted pytest files (test_qbo_mapper_ids, test_liability_recon_math, test_business_type_canon, test_sequential_invoice_numbers, test_voice_intent_item_matcher, test_duplicate_accounts_filter, test_liability_statement_import). All 53 tests passed. Also spot-verified qbo_service.py: all 8 mappers (account, contact, item, invoice, bill, payment, journal_entry, generic_txn) now include company_id[:8] prefix in the top-level `id`, contact ids include {kind} (customer/vendor) discriminator, and payment ids include {direction} (in/out) discriminator — matching the fix described.
critical_code_review_comments: Mapper id shape is consistent across all 8 mappers: `qbo-{cid[:8]}-{kind}-{obj['Id']}`. Good.
Note: cid[:8] gives 16^8 ~ 4B distinct prefixes for hex IDs; collision-safe in practice but not theoretically unique. Acceptable trade-off for id readability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: QBO mapper id-namespacing fix verified. 53/53 targeted tests pass. Full test suite was intentionally not run per request due to unrelated pre-existing env issues.
